# Flow: project kickoff
Load when: decision row 3 (kickoff)

## Preconditions
1. LPM API key with the full profile, or a custom key holding every tool below. The flow mixes portfolio tools (project, team, repository link), planning tools (cycle, milestone, label), requirements tools (baseline, requirement) and the sensitive `add_team_member`; no other preset covers it. Connector → core rule 2.
2. The user named: project name, key (3–6 uppercase letters), workspace, first-cycle dates, milestone outcomes with target dates. Optional: team, governance-role people, routing-profile terms, label names, repository URL, first-baseline name. Ask once for every missing required item; never invent an optional one.
3. Each block is tagged with its owner skill: [workspace-admin], [requirements-scope] (`lpm-requirements-scope`), [plan-work] (`lpm-plan-work`), [code-index] (`lpm-code-index`). Follow that skill's rules for its block. Finish a block's re-read before starting the next one; never run writes of two blocks in one turn.
4. Order (help article `como-comecar-um-projeto`): governance roles → baseline and requirements → activities. Every create here is not idempotent: after a timeout, re-list before any retry.

## Steps
1. [workspace-admin] `list_projects`(workspaceId, includeArchived=true) → same `key` or `name` → STOP (§ Stop and ask row 1).
2. [workspace-admin] Team, only when the user named one: `list_teams`() → reuse the same `name`, else `create_team`(name, description) [A] → keep `teamId` after "ID: ". You become its owner member.
3. [workspace-admin] Team members (skip without a team): reused team → callerUserId (SKILL.md §3) is its `owner`/`admin` in `list_team_members`(teamId), else ask the team owner. `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → `userId`, `userEmail`; `get_user`(userId) → `email`; `add_team_member`(teamId, userId, userEmail, role="member", or `owner`/`admin` when the user asked) [C].
4. [workspace-admin] [C] Show "create_project(name, key, workspaceId, teamId, description)"; on "yes" `create_project`(name, key, workspaceId, teamId, description) [C] → keep `projectId` after "ID: ". Timeout → step 1 before any retry.
5. [workspace-admin] Resolve each named person, with or without a team: `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → `userId` whose `userEmail` (or `get_user` → `displayName`) matches; 0 or 2+ → ask "What is the LPM user id of <person>?". Then `get_project`(projectId) → `update_project`(projectId, governanceAssignments=[{role, userId}] for `project-owner`, `product-owner`, `delivery-lead`, routingProfile=<all nine arrays, [routing-profile](routing-profile.md)>) [C]. Send full objects. You create the project, so the kickoff order naming these people or terms is the owner instruction; quote it.
6. [requirements-scope] First baseline, only on the owner's authorization [O]: `create_requirement_baseline`(projectId, name=<the user's name, default "Escopo inicial" shown in the [O] request>, version="1.0", isCurrent=false) [O] → keep `baselineId` after "ID: ".
7. [requirements-scope] Seed, per requirement the user gave: `create_requirement`(projectId, baselineId, title, description, type, status="pending") [C]; `type` ∈ `functional`, `non-functional`, `interface`, `business`, `technical`.
8. [requirements-scope] Make it current [O]: `update_requirement_baseline`(projectId, baselineId, isCurrent=true) [O]. Send only `isCurrent`.
9. [plan-work] `create_cycle`(projectId, name="<startDate> to <endDate>", startDate, endDate, status="active" when startDate ≤ today, else "upcoming") [A] → keep `cycleId` after "ID: ". Check `endDate` > `startDate` yourself.
10. [plan-work] Per milestone: `create_milestone`(projectId, name=<outcome>, targetDate) [A] → keep the id.
11. [plan-work] Only when the user named labels: `list_labels`() → reuse labels equal after lowercase/trim. Only when none fits: `create_label`(name, color="#RRGGBB") [C], saying labels are universal (every workspace sees them).
12. [code-index] Optional: `create_project_repository_link`(projectId, repositoryUrl="https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>") [C] → keep `id`; `scan_project_repository_readonly`(projectId, repositoryLinkId=<id>) [A]. Code search needs a workspace link: `lpm-code-index`.
13. Activities are created afterwards with `lpm-plan-work`, not in this flow.

## Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| duplicate key or name in step 1 | "A project <key> already exists (<id>). Use it?" |
| steps 6 and 8 without the owner's authorization in this conversation | skip steps 6–8; report "first baseline pending owner authorization"; offer the decision request ([authority-and-owner-decisions](authority-and-owner-decisions.md#decision-request)) |
| "Material baseline publication requires an approved change set" in step 8 (only if a baseline already existed) | STOP → `lpm-requirements-scope` (change set first) |
| governance-role people or routing terms not given | skip that field in step 5; list it under Pending |
| no repository URL | skip step 12 |
| no labels named | skip step 11; never invent a label taxonomy |
| a new label would duplicate an existing meaning | reuse the existing label; ask before creating |

## Verify (legacy exit criteria)
| Criterion | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| project exists | `get_project`(projectId) | `id` and `key` match; `archived == false` |
| ownership exists | `get_project` + `list_team_members`(teamId) | `governanceAssignments` holds the named roles; a team used has ≥1 `owner`/`admin` |
| team members added | `list_team_members`(teamId) | every userId added in step 3 is listed |
| requirements seeded | `list_requirements`(projectId, baselineId) | the number of items equals the number seeded in step 7 |
| repository linked | step 12 scan result | `status == completed` (or step 12 skipped) |
| cycle exists | `get_cycle`(cycleId) | one cycle, `status` as sent (`active` or `upcoming`), dates as sent |
| milestones exist | `list_milestones`(projectId) | every planned milestone with its `targetDate` |
| label taxonomy not duplicated | `list_labels`() | each label created in step 11 has no twin equal after lowercase/trim (or step 11 skipped) |
| execution can start without ambiguity | `get_project_execution_context`(projectId) | an `active` step 9 cycle is in `planning.activeCycles` (an `upcoming` one is checked by the cycle row); `scope.currentBaseline` set (or the named pending item); `planning.openMilestones` lists the milestones |

## Report fields
Scope, project id/key, team, roles, baseline id (or pending), cycle, milestones, labels reused/created, repository link/scan, Pending, Next.
